name: Tetralith (NSC, Linköping)
notes: Use your NAISS project as the Slurm account.
NSC launches MPI programs with mpprun instead of srun.
Run `module avail VASP` on Tetralith and copy the exact module name into the setup commands.
Licensed POTCAR files are provided by NSC to VASP license holders; ask NSC support for the path.
